title: A bounded write preserves outside values
statement: Let $\mu$ be a memory function, and let $dst,j,n$ be natural numbers and $f$ an integer-valued function. If $j\le n$, then writing the values $f(0),\ldots,f(j-1)$ into the $j$ cells starting at $dst$ leaves memory unchanged at every address outside the interval from $dst$ through $dst+n-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ is a memory function from natural numbers to integers
